description: Use this when someone asks about the prices set in their vet clinic's treatment and service catalog, such as the lowest, highest or most recently changed price. Returns price, duration where recorded and last edit time per catalog row, without treatment names. Not for the price of a specific named treatment.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

limit.description: Catalog rows per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50

name: list_procedures

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

procedures.description: Numeric catalog rows, most recently edited first. Names, descriptions, identifiers, patient-linked treatments, diagnoses, notes, reminders and every other free-text or clinical field are excluded.

duration.description: Configured duration, or null when none was recorded

title: Review treatment catalog prices
